definitions.explanation: A reason given to justify or explain one's actions, often implying it may not be entirely valid.
An attempt to explain the circumstances behind something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{訳|わけ}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦するな→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{言|い}い{訳|わけ} often carries a negative nuance, implying the reason may not be genuine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to make an excuse
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ - is no excuse
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ - nothing but excuses
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ}⟦{無用|むよう}→無用：noentry⟧ - no excuses accepted

USAGE:
{言|い}い{訳|わけ} typically implies the speaker is trying to avoid responsibility or make themselves look better, whereas ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ (explanation) is more neutral.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}がましい→言い訳がましい：noentry⟧ - excuse-making, overly apologetic
- ⟦{屁理屈|へりくつ}→屁理屈：15530_herikutsu⟧ - sophistry, specious argument

SURU-VERB USAGE:
{言|い}い{訳|わけ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ can be used as a verb meaning "to make excuses."
